research_item: Backcountry Horseback Ride in Hobble Creek Canyon
name: Hobble Creek Outfitters (meeting point)
address: Hobble Creek Canyon Rd & Left Fork Hobble Creek Canyon Rd, Springville, UT 84663
coord_method: OSM API map.json: shared node 12752789364 where Left Fork Hobble Creek Canyon Rd (way 10225975) meets Hobble Creek Canyon Rd (way 10231202)
notes: The operator's booking page (GoWondo, provider Hobble Creek Outfitters; same text on the two-hour page) gives the meeting point as 'Hobble Creek Road and Left Fork at Hobble Creek Road'. The pin is that junction. The ranch itself is at the north end of Left Fork (hobblecreekoutfitters.com). It has no published street address, and exact directions are sent only after booking. A third-party listing ('90 Hobble Creek Canyon', 40.2278,-111.4703) was not used because it is likely Google-derived. Research's v1 stand-in was 40.161022,-111.514732 (golf course), about 1.2 km west of the junction.
secondary_address: Ranch: north end of Left Hand Fork, Hobble Creek Canyon, Utah County (no street address published)

research_item: Self-Guided Provo River Raft with High Country Adventure
name: High Country Adventure (Provo check-in office)
address: 3702 E Provo Canyon Rd, Provo, UT 84604
coord_method: OSM API map.json: OSM has no named feature. Pinned on the Riverbend guest parking lot and office buildings just east of Vivian Park (parking way 1279368028 at 40.356351,-111.572107; building cluster around 40.3570,-111.5705)
notes: The rafting trip starts at the check-in office with private parking, and a shuttle takes guests to the put-in. The tubing page says the Provo office is at Vivian Park, and weekend tubing (Jun 14–Sep 7) meets at 3362 E Provo Canyon Rd, 1/4 mi south. The pin is good to about 100 m. It replaces the v2 point at 40.3279,-111.6302, which was about 5 km down-canyon near Canyon Glen. The item is on seasonal hold until April 2027.

research_item: Thistle Landslide and Ghost Town Viewpoint
name: Thistle Landslide GeoSight pullout (US-6)
address: US-6 pullout before the double road cut, Spanish Fork Canyon, Utah County, UT
coord_method: OSM API: amenity=parking way 1573252681 beside US-6.
notes: UGS GeoSight: about 12.7 mi from I-15, a large pullout on US-6 just before a massive double road cut, with overlook and signs; the town ruins are about 1.5 mi on via US-89. This parking area is the best OSM match for that pullout, but OSM doesn't name it. Research pinned the Thistle place node (39.992664,-111.497547) instead. Secondary point: Thistle town ruins.

research_item: Hike Silver Lake Trail #036 in American Fork Canyon
name: Silver Lake Trailhead (Trail #036)
address: North side of Silver Lake Flat Reservoir, American Fork Canyon (North Fork), Utah County, UT
coord_method: Nominatim: OSM node 12288622491 'Silver Lake Trailhead' on Silver Lake Trail, Silver Lake Summer Home Area, Utah County.
notes: This is the American Fork Canyon Silver Lake from the Research item (USFS Trail #036, Pleasant Grove Ranger District), not Brighton's Silver Lake in Big Cottonwood Canyon (the other Nominatim hit, Salt Lake County). The USFS page puts the trailhead on the north side of Silver Lake Flat Reservoir; the pin is there, about 620 m north of Research's dam point. The area charges a recreation fee at the canyon booth. Seasonal: summer and fall.
